Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production Heroes of Might and Magic III Awakened Colossus MATERIAL-only correction. EDIT IMAGE 1 ONLY. Image 2 is the approved lower-tier Sentinel MATERIAL reference; transfer ONLY rough petricite and restrained prerendered shading, never its simpler armor shape, crest color, pose or proportions. Image 3 is original Heroes III stone golem for material/rendering language ONLY; do not copy its pixels or shape.
Replace smooth outlined toy-like stone finish with decisively irregular granular/mineral mottling in aged pale off-white petricite. Replace comic black ink seams and uniformly dark panel strokes with warm gray/brown occlusion only in actual joints, reflected cool ambient shadow faces, clear volumetric gradients and modest upper-left highlights. Preserve upgraded weathered gold architectural trim, gold blade-and-feather Demacian chest crest, navy cloth and restrained amber heart/eye insets. It must be a late-1990s richly textured prerendered sculpture, neither vector/cel shading nor glossy contemporary3D. No uniform black contour strokes. Texture should survive at about115px native battle height.
Strict invariants: EXACT original Awakened geometry, stepped shoulder buttresses, head crest, fists, armored feet, gold ornament and crest; EXACT individual action poses, limb angles, facing/camera, proportions, scale, per-cell root and soles. MATERIAL CHANGE ONLY. Never invent poses, add weapons/wings/flight, erase fingers, simplify armor, change identity or replace with the Sentinel. Preserve all cells/layout and wide gutters. Transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, scenery, ground plane, cast shadows or labels.
Image1 is the selected 3columns by 2rows action atlas; keep its exact aspect ratio, layout, 6poses and relative anchors. Each painted figure remains wholly in its original cell with fully transparent gutters. Keep all motion differences including prone/death/turn/casting silhouettes when present. Do not auto-center individual figures. Preserve the original fullimage canvas geometry.
Critical: IMAGE1 is ALREADY the final1536x1024 reference canvas with its EXACT 3x2 normalized atlas packing. Preserve1536x1024, every original silhouette and EXACT head/feet pixel locations. DO NOT move, enlarge, shrink, reframe or re-space any of the six figures. This is a surface texture edit, not redraw or a re-layout. The transparent padding between every image must remain identical. Keep the whole-image composition fixed as provided.
